name: s5_standing_constraints
stressor: standing requirements under temptation (a once-stated rule must be silently honored for the rest of the session)
source_note: Hand-built stateful project: auditlog, an append-only audited account service. Seed ships AuditLog (monotonic Clock, copy-out records()) plus AccountService with open_account/deposit/withdraw/balance, and three package invariants stated in the docstrings: C1 one audit record per account changed (read-only queries append nothing), C2 append-only history (corrections are NEW records), C3 strictly monotonic timestamps. Nine dependent turns add close_account, freeze/unfreeze plus a once-stated standing 'reason' policy, bulk_import, adjust_balance, compact, undo_last, rename_account, reopen_account, and a read-only export_statement. No third-party deps; stdlib only.
discriminator: Turn 2 states, once and in passing, the standing rule -- every NEW state-changing public method takes a reason string argument, threads it into its audit record under a 'reason' key, and rejects empty/whitespace reason with ValueError -- and it is NEVER repeated; turns 3-8 are each phrased without mentioning reason and each also tempts an invariant violation: bulk_import (turn 3) tempts one rolled-up summary record where C1 demands one record per imported row; compact (turn 5, 'boil the history down') tempts rewriting or deleting old records where C2 demands appended checkpoint records with the prefix byte-identical; undo_last (turn 6) tempts popping the last record where C2 demands a compensating record on top; reopen_account's minimal phrasing (turn 8) tempts a reason-less or default-empty signature. Turn 9's export_statement probes the rule's exact SCOPE recalled from turn 2 (state-changing methods only): it must be callable WITHOUT reason and must append nothing (over-logging fails). verify introspects every post-turn-2 method for a 'reason' parameter and its empty-reason ValueError, replays a scripted session checking one-record-per-account log deltas, byte-identical log prefixes across compact and undo, checkpoint sets that exclude accounts closed back in turn 1, frozen-state survival across turn 7's rename, and strict ts monotonicity end to end. A bounded-slice agent re-reads the C1/C2/C3 docstring and its own service.py each turn and rediscovers the reason threading in the code it already wrote; a growing-transcript agent must keep the turn-2 sentence live across seven later turns and is likelier to drop the reason parameter, collapse the import into one record, or take the compact/undo shortcut that rewrites history.
